name: Hearth Biscuit
shortDescription: A hard biscuit from a school hearth.
examineDescription: A hard flat biscuit the size of your palm, scored across the middle so it can be broken in two. It came off the hearth it was baked on and still smells faintly of that fire. The mentors keep a tin of them and hand them out after a first lesson, on the grounds that a student who has just stood a dummy is usually hungry.
